title: Senior Platform Engineer
tagline: Build, operate, and continuously enhance the internal technology platform
compensation: Target starting bands, there may be room outside of these decided on a case by case basis £105K – £125K · Offers Equity
metaDescription: Build, operate, and continuously enhance the internal technology platform

segments.t: Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue.

Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.
If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale.
Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable.
Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio.
Own our observability stack - metrics, logging and distributed tracing - as the foundation of an exceptional reliability culture.
Define and hold SLOs for latency, availability and error rates, and manage capacity to stay comfortably inside them.
Lead incident response: triage and resolve complex production issues, then run blameless post-mortems and ship the fixes as code.
Partner with product engineering teams to remove manual toil and shorten the path from writing code to running it in production.
Hands-on experience operating production systems with an SRE mindset: SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction and blameless post-mortems.
Excellent knowledge of modern cloud architectures (either GCP or AWS), including networking, IAM and managed services.
Demonstrable deep expertise with Docker and Kubernetes at scale, covering cluster design, networking, storage and security.
Proficiency in a modern language such as Typescript, Go, Python or Rust, and a track record of writing well-tested automation.
Experience owning mission-critical operational tooling, including centralised logging or APM (e.g. Datadog, Splunk).
Ability to communicate technical ideas to the wider team and influence how other engineers build and operate their services.
Competitive salary of £105,000 to £125,000
Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory
25 days holiday plus local public holidays
Apple hardware
Private medical insurance through AXA
Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown
Enhanced family leave
Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

title: Staff Product Engineer
metaDescription: The system for revenue teams to build pipeline, accelerate deals, and grow accounts around the clock.

segments.t: Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue.

Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.
If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers that can solve our hardest technical problems, both individually and through technical leadership. You’ll design and build software that creates delightful, groundbreaking user experiences. You’ll play a key role in growing the talent in our engineering organization through mentoring, coaching and hiring, and you’ll resolve our most tricky product issues through an understanding of what’s important to our users and business.
Provide technical leadership for a critical part of Attio’s engineering organization.

You’ll work across teams to design significant parts of our infrastructure, aligning with Attio’s overall technical strategy. You’ll hold a high bar for the output of the teams you work with, ensuring that Attio executes both quickly and with quality.
Raise the bar on how we build and operate software.

You’ll be part of a technical leadership group that sets standards for how we build and operate software at Attio, ensuring that we strive to build robust and maintainable systems that are reliable, scalable and secure.
Grow our engineering talent.

You’ll mentor and coach the engineers you work with, and help ensure we hire the best talent for Attio. You’ll share your knowledge and growth mindset with the team, and be open to new approaches and experiments as software engineering evolves in the age of AI.
Deliver for the business.

You’ll always look to optimize for Attio’s business, ensuring that we make the right trade-offs between delivery and perfection. You’ll strive to understand our customers and users so you can deliver the experiences which are uniquely valuable to them.
First-class technical skills

. First and foremost, you’ll be an excellent technical executor, with an ability to think in systems, not just crank out code. You’ll understand the world of distributed, cloud-native systems, and intuitively create the right interfaces to allow teams to innovate in parallel.
Proven technical leadership credentials.

You’ll have a track record of not just personal execution, but of delivering projects through others. You’ll be able to break down large, complex problems into smaller, independent goals that others can own. You’ll understand how technical architecture impacts ability to deliver, and to maintain systems for the long term, and be sensitive to the need to pick the right compromise.
A growth mindset.

Software engineering is changing rapidly in the age of AI, and you’ll understand the need to be open-minded and to experiment. You’ll be keen to teach, and to learn from the experience of others. You’ll relish the challenge of working in an area that’s new to you, and enjoy the discomfort that leads to personal growth.
A passion for growing the skills of others

. As you deliver projects through your technical leadership, you’ll be keen to grow the next generation of technical leaders. You’ll have demonstrated impact through mentoring and coaching, and be able to flex your style depending on the needs of your colleagues. You’ll also be passionate about hiring the right talent for Attio.
A focus on the product and customer.

You’ll have strong opinions on what makes a great product, and a keen desire to deliver the things which generate value for Attio’s customers. You’ll be curious to learn about how our product is used in the field, and have an understanding of how to use data to ensure we’re building the right thing.
Competitive salary : £135K- 170K
Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory
25 days holiday plus local public holidays
Apple hardware
[In the UK] Private medical insurance through AXA
[In the UK] Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown
Enhanced family leave
Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

Turn our narrative into distinctive content and programs across Attio’s owned channels.

Shape the voices and external presence of our founders and leadership team across social, content, media, and events.
PR & earned media:
Build relationships with journalists and media, creating opportunities for others to tell Attio’s story.
Employee & internal comms:
Help our team understand and tell Attio’s story through internal communications, employer brand, and employee advocacy.
Company announcements:
Lead communications for major moments including fundraising, company news, launches, and other key milestones.
Communications experience:
7+ years across communications, content, editorial, PR, or brand, ideally within high-growth startups.
Exceptional storytelling:
You can turn complex ideas into simple, distinctive, and compelling narratives.
Editorial judgement:
You have strong instincts for what makes a great story, what audiences will care about, and where it should be told.
Executive partnership:
You’re comfortable working directly with founders and senior leaders to shape their voice and external presence.
Media understanding:
You understand the modern communications landscape across press, social, creators, podcasts, events, and emerging channels.

You can move between long-term narrative building and high-stakes, fast-moving communications with confidence.
Builder mindset:
You’re comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work , from developing the narrative to writing the final copy.
Eye for quality:
You hold a high bar for everything Attio puts into the world and know what great communications looks like.

intro.text: Purpose of the role and role description

segments.t: As we scale into 2027 and beyond, we're adding a Senior Recruiter in New York to extend our reach into the world's most competitive hiring markets.

In this role, you'll own full-cycle recruiting across a range of functions, with a particular focus on building Attio's presence and network in the US market, where our teams are heavily weighted to GTM, specifically Sales, Success, Support and Marketing. You'll also play a role in connecting top talent in NYC to opportunities across Attio's global team, including London and SF. You'll work closely with GTM Executives, our Hiring Managers and the Talent team, partnering on structured, calibrated hiring processes that consistently raise the bar.

This is a recruiting role for someone who recognises the impact of great hiring on company success and who see’s this as an opportunity to perfect the craft of calibration, engagement and network building to become one of the best in their field in this market.
You will be an early member of our New York office, helping to embed a strong hiring culture as Attio grows it's US presence.
Skills
Full cycle skills for briefings, partnering, calibration and networking
Role launch design and sourcing strategy execution across multiple channels
Candidate pipeline management and data hygiene
Experience
High-growth AI, B2B SaaS or tech startup recruitment experience either in agency or in house
Proven track record hiring across IC and manager level hiring. Bonus for exec
Deep familiarity with US talent networks [GTM] and building teams across SF and NYC.
Behaviours
Resilient - able to maintain momentum in a market where the bar is genuinely high, and sees that bar as an opportunity rather than a blocker
Resourceful - finds creative paths to candidates, doesn't rely on inbound
Proactive - surfaces ideas, spots gaps, doesn't wait to be directed
High agency - treats every open role like their own problem to solve
Facilitator, not the hero - understands that great recruiting is hiring manager-led; their job is to calibrate, enable and accelerate
Evangelism - deep belief in what Attio is building
Stage 1 - Introduction
Motivations, market background, understanding of high-bar recruiting environments.
Stage 2 , Track Record
Deep dive into recruiting track record. Roles closed, hiring bar held, sourcing methods, and how they have operated in high-growth and competitive US markets.
Stage 3 , Panel Interview
Working with Hiring managers, commercial judgement, market understanding, existing networks, working style, New York office team, Talent team.
Stage 4 , Executive Interview
Mission alignment, trajectory, and final calibration on the type of talent hire Attio needs in New York.
Compensation
Salary range $130k - $170k
Equity
Holiday
25 days holiday + local public holidays
Healthcare
We use Sequoia One as our PEO and offer access to their group healthcare plans through: Cigna and Kaiser for healthcare (availability depends on your location)
Guardian for dental and vision
Current Provider: We’re under the Sequoia One group plan, managed through Empower.
Parental leave
Birthing parent: Eligible employees are entitled to 16 weeks of fully compensated leave following the birth, adoption, or placement of a child.
Non birthing parents: Eligible employees are entitled to 8 weeks of fully compensated leave following the birth, adoption, or placement of a child.

We think deeply about how people work together, design systems that scale, and remove friction before it’s felt – orchestrating every step toward value in lockstep with Design, Engineering, GTM, and our users.

Work with engineering to design systems that are simple to use but flexible and durable

Comfort in navigating ambiguity. You can turn incomplete information into structured decisions and clear next steps.
Excellent product instincts. You know how to translate complex technical systems and customer problems into simple concepts and elegant user experiences.

Fluency in technical storytelling. You can can frame technical changes in ways that help GTM teams strengthen positioning and customer understanding.
Founder mentality. You take responsibility for outcomes end to end, and move strategical and tactical decisions forward.
